articles.title: Discovering Conceptual Metaphors Across Topics and Media Types
articles.abstract: Conceptual metaphors guide our thinking and actions by allowing us to reason about more abstract experiences (e.g., paying taxes) in terms of more concrete or embodied experiences (e.g., carrying a physical load) (Lakoff and Johnson, 2011). It follows that different conceptual metaphors can result in different reasoning: framing paying taxes as an investment in a community rather than a physical load leads to a very different outlook on taxation. Identifying the conceptual metaphors guiding a speaker or writer thus helps to reveal their framing of events. Though these metaphors can't be observed directly, groups of linguistic metaphors, metaphorical expressions as they appear in language, serve as evidence for them. Motivated by this, we present an unsupervised method that extracts linguistic metaphors from a corpus and uses a structured clustering approach to form groups corresponding to conceptual metaphors. Using this method, we point to key topical and framing differences in left- vs. right-leaning podcasts. For example, left-leaning podcasts tend to conceptualize media stories as a weapon, while right-leaning sources commonly discuss the economy as a system subject to vertical changes.
articles.titleCn: 跨主题和媒体类型发现概念隐喻
articles.abstractCn: 概念隐喻通过让我们能够用更具体或具身体验（例如，背负实体负担）来推理更抽象的体验（例如，缴纳税款），从而指导我们的思维和行动（Lakoff和Johnson，2011）。因此，不同的概念隐喻可能导致不同的推理：将缴纳税款视为对社区的投入而不是实体负担，会导致对税收截然不同的看法。识别指导说话人或作者的概念隐喻，有助于揭示他们对事件的框架。尽管这些隐喻不能直接观察到，但语言中的语言隐喻群组，即隐喻表达，作为它们的证据。受此启发，我们提出了一种无监督方法，从语料库中提取语言隐喻，并使用结构化聚类方法形成对应于概念隐喻的群组。使用这种方法，我们指出了左倾和右倾播客在主题和框架上的关键差异。例如，左倾播客倾向于将媒体故事概念化为武器，而右倾来源通常将经济讨论为受垂直变化影响的系统。

articles.title: Factorized Hypothesis Search for Evidence-to-Taxonomy Retrieval
articles.abstract: Large-taxonomy retrieval often assumes that the input already expresses the target concept. In many settings, however, the input is indirect evidence, such as a table cell whose meaning depends on its row, column, datatype, and context. We call this mismatch the retrieval readiness gap. Our analysis shows that the current index retrieves the target reliably when its semantics are explicit, while raw evidence often leaves it deep in the ranking. We propose Factorized Hypothesis Search (FHS), which maintains multiple partial interpretations over named semantic dimensions. These hypotheses support structured query rendering, multi-hypothesis retrieval, and dimension-level candidate verification. On both financial taxonomy tagging and CodiEsp clinical coding tasks, FHS achieves the best Recall@1, MRR, and final accuracy among the non-oracle methods. Replacing the factorized hypothesis path with a free-text ensemble causes the largest drop in head-ranking performance, while sequential refinement provides no additional gain over FHS's strong parallel first round.
articles.titleCn: 证据到分类检索的因子化假设搜索
articles.abstractCn: 大规模分类检索通常假设输入已明确表达目标概念。然而，在许多场景中，输入只是间接证据，例如其含义取决于行、列、数据类型和上下文的表格单元格。我们将这种不匹配称为检索准备度差距。我们的分析表明，当索引的语义明确时，当前索引能可靠地检索目标，而原始证据往往使其在排名中靠后。我们提出了分解假设搜索（FHS），该技术维护多个关于命名语义维度的部分解释。这些假设支持结构化查询渲染、多假设检索和维度级别的候选验证。在金融分类标注和CodiEsp临床编码任务中，FHS在非或然方法中实现了最高的Recall@1、MRR和最终准确率。用自由文本集成替换分解假设路径导致头排名性能下降最大，而顺序优化并未为FHS强大的并行第一轮提供额外增益。

articles.title: Pre-Inference Routing for Cost-Efficient Document Field Extraction
articles.abstract: Most document-extraction systems use a single model for all documents. This is simple but can be costly for easy cases and less effective for difficult ones. We examine whether we can predict a document's difficulty before extraction using inexpensive, document-based signals, and use this to choose between a cheaper and a stronger extractor. We find that routing only helps if two conditions hold: the cheaper model fails often enough to make routing worthwhile, and those failures can be predicted from visible features such as image quality and layout. We turn these into a practical test and apply it to five genres. When both conditions are met, the calibrated router reduces cost by 31-33% on receipts and 77% on degraded ad-buy forms while keeping quality within 0.02 F1 of always choosing the large model. Routing does not help if either condition is missing, as with clean digital invoices or nutrition labels that are already easy to read. A small labeled pilot can predict whether routing will work, and in the two cases where we ran it first, the prediction was correct. A simple bag-of-words router works about as well as engineered features, showing that the main limit is the genre, not the router design; we use interpretable features to help explain which genres can be routed. The router must be retrained for each dataset and does not transfer across datasets, even within the same genre. These results hold for two model pairs with cost differences of 5x and 3x.
articles.titleCn: 面向低成本文档字段提取的预推理路由
articles.abstractCn: 大多数文档提取系统对所有文档使用单一模型。这种方式简单，但对于简单情况可能成本过高，对于复杂情况则效果不佳。我们研究了是否能在提取前，利用低成本、基于文档的信号预测文档难度，并据此在更便宜但更强的提取器之间进行选择。我们发现，路由只有在满足两个条件时才有效：更便宜的模型失败频率足够高，使得路由变得值得；并且这些失败可以通过可见特征（如图像质量和布局）进行预测。我们将这些条件转化为实际测试，并应用于五种类型。当两个条件都满足时，校准路由器在收据上降低成本31-33%，在退化的广告购买表单上降低成本77%，同时保持质量在始终选择大模型时的0.02 F1范围内。如果缺少任一条件，路由将无效，例如干净的数字发票或已经易于阅读的营养标签。一个小型标记试点可以预测路由是否有效，在我们进行的两个案例中，预测结果均正确。简单的词袋路由器与工程化特征效果相当，表明主要限制是类型，而不是路由器设计；我们使用可解释特征来解释哪些类型可以进行路由。路由器必须为每个数据集重新训练，并且不会在不同数据集之间迁移，即使是在同一类型中。这些结果适用于成本差异为5倍和3倍的两个模型对。

articles.title: Beyond "AI Language": The case for the idiolectal nature of LLM output
articles.abstract: While large language model outputs are frequently analysed as a collective super variety termed "AI language," this chapter argues that this perspective coexists with distinct, model-specific linguistic signatures akin to human idiolects. We analyse two datasets of LLM-generated texts on societal topics: a 2024 corpus of six models (Improta et al. 2024) and a newly generated 2026 corpus using the same prompts featuring six contemporary models. Our findings, utilising computational descriptors and stylometric principal component analysis reveal a generational shift between the style of the 2024 and 2026 cohorts, while demonstrating that each individual model maintains a unique linguistic profile. This multi-layered interplay is illustrated by contraction frequencies, which vary from over 1,200 to over 30,000 per million words within the same cohort of models (2026). Ultimately, we conclude that treating LLM output as idiolectal in nature provides a valuable framework with potential implications for research on variation and change, LLM-generated text detection, forensic linguistics and usage-based approaches to language.
articles.comment: 33 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Submitted as a chapter to the post-workshop volume "Corpus Linguistics 2040" (Digital Linguistics series)
articles.titleCn: 超越“AI语言”：论LLM输出的个人语言特性
articles.abstractCn: 虽然大型语言模型的输出通常被分析为一个名为“人工智能语言”的集体超级变体，但本章认为这一视角与特定模型独有的语言特征共存，这些特征类似于人类的个人语言风格。我们分析了两个关于社会主题的大型语言模型生成文本数据集：Improta等人（2024）的2024年六模型语料库，以及使用相同提示、包含六种当代模型的新生成的2026年语料库。我们的研究利用计算描述符和文体学主成分分析，揭示了2024年和2026年两组模型风格之间的代际差异，同时表明每个独立模型都保持独特的语言特征。这种多层次的相互作用通过缩合频率得以说明，在同一组模型（2026年）中，缩合频率从每百万词超过1,200次变化到超过30,000次。最终，我们得出结论，将大型语言模型的输出视为个人语言风格性质，提供了一个有价值的框架，对变异与变化研究、大型语言模型生成文本检测、法医语言学以及基于使用方法的语言研究具有潜在影响。

articles.title: Divergent Response Modes in Frontier Language Models Under Steering Pressure
articles.abstract: Frontier language models are trained using distinct data, objectives, and safety pipelines. Whether these differences produce measurably different behaviors under explicit steering pressure remains underexplored. This study evaluates behavioral steerability across six frontier models from six developers using 300 paired base and steered items over three categories: values-conflict, reasoning-elicitation, and reasoning-suppression (plus 40 validation items). All six models act as blind peer judges and classify every response based on fixed behavioral rubrics. The resulting 24,480 judgments are scored by leave-one-out consensus. We find that models differ not just in how much steering shifts their behavior but in what kind (mode) of response they give, and some response modes appear in only one or two of them. GPT-5 deflects requests to disclose its reasoning while leaving its answer intact (99% vs. 0% for all other models). Claude Opus 4.7 and GPT-5 resist explicit suppression instructions and in different ways. Using Llama as the open-weight model, we trace the largest behavioral split to its internals. A linear probe decodes the behavior from the residual stream at 0.87 held-out accuracy while injecting that direction during generation drives the behavior from 0% to 86% across an intervention sweep. Every finding holds under both a token-budget remediation and a control experiment with a hypothesis-blind judgment prompt.
articles.titleCn: 在引导压力下前沿语言模型的发散响应模式
articles.abstractCn: 前沿语言模型使用不同的数据、目标和安全流程进行训练。这些差异在明确的引导压力下是否会产生可衡量的行为差异仍待深入探索。本研究通过使用300对基于三个类别的基准和引导项（价值观冲突、推理诱发和推理抑制，外加40个验证项）来评估六个来自不同开发者的前沿模型的行为引导能力。所有六个模型均作为盲法同行评审员，根据固定的行为评分标准对每项响应进行分类。产生的24,480项判断通过留一法共识进行评分。我们发现，模型不仅在引导压力下行为变化的程度上有差异，而且在给出的响应类型（模式）上也有差异，某些响应模式仅出现在其中一到两个模型中。GPT-5会回避披露其推理过程，同时保留其答案（与其他所有模型相比，其比例为99%对0%）。Claude Opus 4.7和GPT-5对明确的抑制指令表现出抵抗，但方式不同。以Llama作为开放权重模型，我们追踪到最大的行为差异源自其内部机制。线性探针从残差流中解码行为，准确率可达0.87，而在生成过程中注入该方向引导时，通过干预扫描将行为从0%驱动至86%。所有发现均在采用代币预算补救措施和假设盲法判断提示的控制实验中得到了验证。

articles.title: Model Confidence Under Answer-Preserving Attacks: An Informativeness-Manipulability Frontier
articles.abstract: Deployed vision-language systems often gate their answers on confidence, making confidence robustness relevant to oversight. We study confidence readouts under white-box, image-only attacks constrained to preserve the generated answer byte-identically. Under a reachability assumption, an unmovable readout cannot outperform the answer-string accuracy prior, whose pooled value is 0.617. Independently of that assumption, a uniform amplitude certificate below a measurable threshold guarantees adversarial discrimination above the same floor. Across four vision-language models, three visual question answering benchmarks, five deployed confidence channels and two defense estimators, direct or surrogate-aimed attacks produce itemwise feasible perturbations that refute this uniform certificate in all 84 estimator-by-cell combinations. Coordinated correctness-label-aware attacks drive adversarial discrimination to or below the answer-string floor in all sixty deployed-channel cells, including all fifty-nine that begin above it. Hidden-state interventions and an open-ended text-model activation-space replication show that comparable confidence movement can be induced at the representation level rather than only through adversarial images. None of four tested defense families establishes a robust alternative under the specific evaluation applied to it. In a confidence-gated simulation, a coordinated token-probability attack transferred to a hidden-state gate causes up to 84.8% of previously rejected wrong answers to become accepted. After reweighting to each benchmark's natural correctness prevalence, accepted accuracy falls below the no-gate baseline in eight of twelve cells under transfer and all twelve under a direct gate-aimed attack. Under the studied threat model and budget, confidence is therefore an integrity-sensitive rather than intrinsically robust oversight signal.
articles.titleCn: 在答案保留攻击下模型的置信度：信息量-操控性边界
articles.abstractCn: 部署的视觉语言系统通常根据置信度来限制其答案，使得置信度鲁棒性对监督至关重要。我们研究了在白盒、仅针对图像的攻击下，且攻击被约束为保持生成答案字节不变时的置信度输出。在可达性假设下，一个不可移动的读数无法优于答案字符串的先验准确率，其池化值为0.617。独立于该假设，一个低于可测量阈值的均匀幅度证书可保证对抗性区分度高于同一基准。在四个视觉语言模型、三个视觉问答基准、五个部署的置信度通道和两个防御估计器中，直接或代理目标攻击产生的逐项可行扰动，在所有84个估计器-单元格组合中均反驳了这一均匀证书。协调的正确标签感知攻击将对抗性区分度驱动至或低于答案字符串基准，包括所有59个开始高于该基准的部署通道单元格。隐藏状态干预和开放式文本模型激活空间复制表明，可比的置信度移动可以在表示级别而非仅通过对抗性图像诱导。在四种测试的防御家族中，在应用于它们的特定评估下，均未建立鲁棒的替代方案。在置信度门控模拟中，协调的token概率攻击转移到隐藏状态门控，导致高达84.8%的先前被拒绝的错误答案被接受。在重新加权至每个基准的自然正确性流行度后，在迁移和直接门控目标攻击下，接受准确率在十二个单元格中的八个低于无门控基线，在所有十二个单元格中低于直接门控攻击。在所研究的威胁模型和预算下，置信度因此是一个对完整性敏感而非本质上鲁棒的监督信号。

articles.title: Which Decisions Low-Bit Quantization Breaks, and How to Predict Them
articles.abstract: Quantization is known to hurt below four bits, but nobody can say which of a model's decisions will change at a given bit-width. This matters most where a model acts rather than answers: a compressed agent stops calling its tools and, one bit lower, loses roughly half its safety refusals, while benchmark scores barely move. Prior work assumes the added noise has a roughly fixed size, which would make confident decisions safe. We measure the decision instead: the margin, the picked option's score minus its best alternative's, tracked before and after quantization across 16 models from 8 families under round-to-nearest, seven under AWQ, two under GPTQ and one under GGUF, at 8 down to 2 bits. The damage is proportional, not fixed in size: the margin is multiplied by a factor that collapses with bit-width (median 0.86 at 4 bits, 0.33 at 3, 0.00 at 2), which we call margin shrinkage. Contraction removes the protection a large margin affords; the model's own biases pick the direction: at 3 bits the decision to call a tool collapses toward inaction while the choice of which tool is untouched. No additive account, including one whose noise grows with the margin, wins a single damaged whether-to-call or safety cell (378 of 378). Given a condition's own constants the relation predicts held-out flip rates to a median 1.7 points, calibrated per decision (error 0.004 over 161,744 predictions), no flip used in the fit. Borrowed constants are wrong by 18-33 points at 3 bits, so the paired margin set has to be measured per model and bit-width: it locates breaking decisions without replacing measurement. At 4 bits the measurement is anchored to behaviour (the most likely token over the whole vocabulary is one of the item's two options in 85% of tool items); we treat the 2-bit floor as where the instrument stops measuring. No label-free repair we tested recovers more than one more bit does.
articles.comment: 18 pages, 9 figures, 8 tables. Under review at the Third Workshop on Uncertainty-Aware NLP (UncertaiNLP), EMNLP 2026 (non-archival)
articles.titleCn: 哪些决策会被低比特量化破坏，以及如何预测它们
articles.abstractCn: 量化在低于四比特时已知会带来损害，但无人能说在特定比特宽度下模型的哪个决策会发生变化。这在与模型行动而非回答相关的场景中最为关键：一个压缩的代理停止调用其工具，而在比特宽度降低一位后，它大约会失去一半的安全拒绝，而基准分数几乎未变。先前工作假设添加的噪声大小大致固定，这会使自信的决策变得安全。我们测量了决策本身：边距，即选定选项的分数减去其最佳替代选项的分数，在量化前后对来自8个系列的16个模型进行追踪，包括四舍五入至最近值、七舍入至AWQ、两舍入至GPTQ和一舍入至GGUF，比特宽度从8降至2。损害是按比例的，而非固定大小：边距乘以一个随比特宽度缩减的因子（四比特时中位数为0.86，三比特时为0.33，二比特时为0.00），我们称之为边距收缩。收缩消除了大边距提供保护；模型的自身偏见决定了方向：在三比特时，调用工具的决策倾向于不行动，而选择哪个工具则不受影响。没有任何加性解释，包括其噪声随边距增长的解释，能在单个受损的调用或安全单元（378/378）中获胜。给定条件的自身常数，关系预测保留的翻转率中位数为1.7点，按决策校准（161,744次预测中误差为0.004），拟合中未使用翻转。借用的常数在三比特时错误18-33点，因此配对的边距集必须按模型和比特宽度测量：它定位了关键决策，而不取代测量。在四比特时，测量基于行为（在整个词汇中最可能的标记在工具项的85%中是该项目两个选项之一）；我们将二比特的底部视为仪器停止测量的点。我们测试的任何无标签修复都不如再增加一位比特能恢复更多。

articles.title: TradeVerse: A Longitudinal Benchmark of Political Negotiation in International Trade
articles.abstract: LLMs are increasingly being applied to tasks involving institutional and political texts, but existing benchmarks evaluate them on isolated documents or single tasks. In realpolitik, negotiations are longitudinal data, where participating parties can align or argue over multiple iterations and each turn is an outcome of the previous turns, hence, understanding one turn requires tracking everything before it. We introduce TradeVerse, a benchmark built from the World Trade Organisation (WTO) specific trade concerns, where member states challenge one another and exchange arguments over multiple rounds, sometimes for years. We, in TradeVerse, reconstruct minutes of $1170$ meetings, spanning across 5 groups and $89$ product groups and define three tasks: first, the system has to analyze the longitudinal meeting records and predict the harmonized system codes (HS chapters) of the products under discussion in the particular meeting, second, we examine whether the system, upon analyzing the anonymized content of the meeting, can guess the name of the responding country and third, we ask the system to play the role of the responding country and provide the statement for the very last round. All labels are recovered directly from the proceedings, requiring no manual annotation. Our experiments highlight the challenges these tasks pose for current LLMs. To the best of our knowledge, TradeVerseis the first benchmark to investigate potential of LLMs in understanding longitudinal political trade negotiations.
articles.titleCn: TradeVerse：国际贸易中政治谈判的纵向基准
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地应用于涉及机构和政治文本的任务，但现有的基准测试通常在孤立文档或单一任务上评估它们。在现实政治中，谈判是纵向数据，参与各方可以在多个回合中达成一致或进行争论，每一轮都是先前轮次的结果，因此理解某一轮次需要追踪其之前的所有内容。我们引入了TradeVerse，这是一个基于世界贸易组织（WTO）特定贸易问题的基准测试，其中成员国相互挑战并在多轮中交换论点，有时持续数年。在TradeVerse中，我们重建了1170次会议的会议记录，涵盖5个组和89个产品组，并定义了三项任务：首先，系统必须分析纵向会议记录并预测特定会议中讨论的产品协调制度编码（HS章节）；其次，我们检验系统在分析会议匿名内容后能否猜测回应国的名称；第三，我们要求系统扮演回应国的角色，并提供最后一轮的声明。所有标签均直接从会议记录中恢复，无需人工标注。我们的实验突出了这些任务对当前LLMs提出的挑战。据我们所知，TradeVerse是首个研究LLMs在理解纵向政治贸易谈判中潜力的基准测试。

articles.title: Don't `Well, Actually' Me Unless You Know What You're Talking About: Weak Presupposition Verification Degrades General QA Performance
articles.abstract: False-presupposition QA (FPQA) tests LLMs on their ability to identify false presuppositions in questions and abstain or correct them rather than reinforcing false assumptions. The common approach reduces the task to prompting LLMs to extract presuppositions and fact checking each presupposition. While the performance on dedicated benchmarks keeps improving, evaluation largely focuses on questions with false presuppositions (FPQs) while ignoring the performance on ``normal'' questions (TPQs). Since many benchmarks over-represent FPQs compared to their natural occurrence, the result is that performance on these benchmarks doesn't reflect real-world QA performance. Through extensive experiments across various model families, sizes, and benchmarks, we show that methods that perform better on FPQs tend to perform worse on TPQs. Our analysis reveals this is the result of weak fact checking modules that reject also true presuppositions. We hope our findings will help guide future work toward FPQA methods that generalize well to realistic settings.
articles.titleCn: 除非你真的知道自己在说什么，否则别跟我来这套“实际上”：弱预设验证会降低通用问答的性能
articles.abstractCn: 虚假预设问答（FPQA）测试大型语言模型识别问题中虚假预设的能力，并要求模型拒绝或修正这些预设，而不是强化错误假设。常见的方法是将任务简化为提示大型语言模型提取预设并逐一进行事实核查。尽管在专用基准上的表现持续提升，但评估主要集中于具有虚假预设的问题（FPQs），而忽略了“正常”问题（TPQs）的表现。由于许多基准过度代表了FPQs与其自然出现频率相比，因此这些基准上的结果并不能反映现实世界的问答性能。通过跨多种模型家族、规模和基准的广泛实验，我们表明，在FPQs上表现更好的方法往往在TPQs上表现更差。我们的分析揭示，这是由于事实核查模块较弱，导致它们也会拒绝真实的预设。我们希望我们的发现能指导未来工作，朝着开发出在现实场景中泛化能力更强的FPQA方法的方向发展。

articles.title: Confidence Estimation for Financial Vision-Language Models in Chart and Document Understanding
articles.abstract: LVLMs are increasingly used to read financial charts, tables, and documents, where a single misread figure can move a decision and the most authoritative-looking answer is sometimes one the model produced without reading the exhibit. The operational question is therefore trust, not accuracy: which answers can be acted on, and which escalated to a reviewer. We evaluate seven confidence estimators, three inference-only and four trained internal probes, across five open-weight LVLMs and four conditions from three financial visual question-answering benchmarks, one bilingual; every probe is trained only on natural images and applied to finance without adaptation, so the results measure out-of-distribution transfer. Three findings hold. First, the scarce property is calibration, not ranking: the inference baselines rank correct above incorrect answers competitively but are badly overconfident, calibration error far above what a threshold can tolerate, and only the trained probes produce a thresholdable score. Second, reliability is structured rather than global, along two axes a practitioner can read directly: the best estimator shifts with both model and task, none leading more than eight of twenty (model, condition) cells, and a controlled bilingual contrast exposes an apparent language robustness as a composition artifact that dissolves once models are read one at a time. Third, cast as deferral under an error budget, how much can be safely automated is set first by the model's competence and only narrowed by its confidence, so deferral clears a real share of the easiest condition and almost none of the hardest, near zero at a strict 5% budget. Two trained probes carry the calibration a deferral policy needs, and among them only the grounding-aware one lowers its confidence on answers a model gives without using the figure, separating detected non-grounding from a fluent guess.
articles.titleCn: 金融视觉语言模型在图表和文档理解中的置信度估计
articles.abstractCn: LVLMs正越来越多地用于读取金融图表、表格和文档，其中单个误读的数字就可能影响决策，而有时最具权威性的答案反而是模型在不读取展品的情况下生成的。因此，操作性问题在于信任而非准确性：哪些答案可以采取行动，哪些需要升级给审查者。我们在五个开放权重LVLMs和三个金融视觉问答基准（其中一个为双语）的四个条件下，评估了七种置信度估计器，其中三种为仅推理，四种为训练后的内部探针。每个探针仅使用自然图像进行训练，并在金融领域直接应用，因此结果衡量的是分布外迁移。有三个发现。首先，稀缺性在于校准而非排序：推理基线在正确答案和错误答案的排序上竞争激烈，但严重过度自信，校准误差远超阈值可容忍的范围，只有训练后的探针产生了可阈值化的分数。其次，可靠性是结构化的而非全局性的，沿着两个从业者可以直接读取的轴：最佳估计器会随着模型和任务的变化而变化，没有一种估计器在超过二十个（模型，条件）单元中占主导地位，一个受控的双语对比暴露了明显的语言鲁棒性，这种鲁棒性作为组合效应在单独读取模型时消失。第三，在错误预算下将其视为延迟处理，可以安全自动化的程度首先由模型的胜任力决定，然后才由其置信度缩小，因此延迟处理清除了实际上一部分最简单条件，而几乎没有最困难条件，在严格的5%预算下几乎为零。两种训练后的探针携带了校准延迟处理策略所需的条件，其中只有基于基础的探针降低了模型在不使用图的情况下给出的答案的置信度，将检测到的非基础与流畅的猜测区分开来。

articles.title: Lost in Interpolation: Why Predictive Feedback Fails in Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Soft-masking accelerates the convergence of Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs). Existing formulations build this blend with linear interpolation (LERP) in the raw embedding space, which implicitly treats that space as Euclidean. We analyze the embedding space of MDLMs and find that the mask and predicted-token embeddings maintain a near-constant angle of (\approx 73^\circ) throughout training, while embedding norms remain essentially flat across vocabulary-frequency rank. These indicate a hyperspherical geometry, for which LERP is the wrong interpolation primitive. We introduce Spherical Soft-Masking (S-SM), a drop-in replacement that aggregates the top-(k) predictions with a Fr'echet mean on the hypersphere and blends this mean with the mask direction using spherical linear interpolation (SLERP), then restores the native mask norm. We evaluate S-SM on continued pre-training of a released 169M-parameter MDLM checkpoint across a wide range of inference-time step budgets, SLERP feedback avoids the training degradation that LERP feedback induces and delivers MAUVE gains of up to 2x over the vanilla MDLM baseline and 27.5-56.1% over TopK/LERP at various sampling budgets, alongside consistently lower generative perplexity (16.9-19.6% over the baseline), while leaving output entropy and convergence essentially unchanged.
articles.titleCn: 迷失于插值：预测性反馈为何在扩散语言模型中失效
articles.abstractCn: 软掩码加速了掩码扩散语言模型（MDLMs）的收敛。现有的公式通过原始嵌入空间中的线性插值（LERP）构建这种混合，这隐含地将该空间视为欧几里得空间。我们分析了MDLMs的嵌入空间，发现掩码和预测词嵌入在整个训练过程中保持近恒定的角度（≈73°），而嵌入范数在词汇频率排序上基本保持平坦。这表明存在超球面几何结构，而LERP是错误的插值原语。我们引入了球形软掩码（S-SM），这是一种即插即用的替代方案，它在超球面上使用Fr'echet均值聚合前k个预测，然后使用球形线性插值（SLERP）将此均值与掩码方向混合，最后恢复原始掩码范数。我们在释放的169M参数MDLM检查点的持续预训练上评估了S-SM，在广泛的推理时间步预算范围内，SLERP反馈避免了LERP反馈引起的训练退化，并在各种采样预算下比原始MDLM基线提高了高达2倍的MAUVE增益，比TopK/LERP提高了27.5-56.1%，同时生成困惑度始终较低（比基线低16.9-19.6%），而输出熵和收敛性基本保持不变。

articles.title: GRASP: Reinforcing Language Model Anonymizers with Group Relative Policy Optimization
articles.abstract: Large language models can infer sensitive personal attributes, such as age, location, and occupation, from ordinary text, turning everyday writing into a privacy risk. Adversarial anonymization defends against this by rewriting a text with a capable language model that also plays the attacker, but it needs a powerful model at inference time and thus sends private text to a third party, the very exposure anonymization should prevent. Recent work distills this behavior into a small on-device model using supervised fine-tuning and direct preference optimization (DPO), but DPO only imitates the teacher's offline choices and never directly optimizes the privacy--utility objective we care about. We introduce \textbf{GRASP} (\textbf{G}roup-\textbf{R}elative \textbf{A}nonymization via \textbf{S}elf-refinement \textbf{P}olicy-optimization), which reinforces the local anonymizer online with Group Relative Policy Optimization. A single small model acts as anonymizer, adversary, and utility judge, trained against a self-generated reward that hides attributes while preserving meaning, with a design that guards against reward hacking. Trained on Llama-3.1-8B, \ours{} improves the privacy--utility trade-off over the DPO-distilled baseline, consistently across three independent LLM judges. Against adversarial anonymization driven by frontier models such as Gemini~2.5~Flash and Claude, it achieves a comparable or better overall trade-off while removing substantially more private information, and it runs entirely on-device at roughly $1\%$ of the GPT-4o teacher's cost.
articles.titleCn: GRASP：使用组相对策略优化强化语言模型匿名化
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型能够从普通文本中推断敏感的个人属性，例如年龄、位置和职业，将日常写作变成了隐私风险。对抗性匿名化通过使用一个强大的语言模型来重写文本，该模型同时扮演攻击者的角色，来防御这一问题，但它需要在推理时使用一个强大的模型，因此将私密文本发送给第三方，而这恰恰是匿名化应该防止的暴露。最近的研究将这种行为蒸馏到一个小型的设备模型中，使用监督微调和直接偏好优化（DPO），但DPO仅模仿教师的离线选择，从未直接优化我们关心的隐私-效用目标。我们引入了\textbf{GRASP}（\textbf{G}roup-\textbf{R}elative \textbf{A}nonymization via \textbf{S}elf-refinement \textbf{P}olicy-optimization），它通过组相对策略优化在线强化本地匿名化器。单个小型模型充当匿名化器、攻击者和效用评判者，通过自我生成的奖励进行训练，该奖励隐藏属性同时保留意义，并具有防止奖励攻击的设计。在Llama-3.1-8B上训练后，\ours{}在三个独立的LLM评判者中始终优于DPO蒸馏的基线，提升了隐私-效用的权衡。针对由前沿模型如Gemini~2.5~Flash和Claude驱动的对抗性匿名化，它在实现相当或更好的整体权衡的同时，大幅减少了隐私信息的暴露，并且完全在设备上运行，成本仅为GPT-4o教师的约1%。

articles.title: Measuring the Cross-Lingual Comprehension Gap: How the language of the evidence shapes what language models understand
articles.abstract: Language models are often evaluated as though capabilities demonstrated in English remain equally available when the same content is presented in other languages. Traditional multilingual benchmarks rarely isolate language while holding content, question, reference answer, model, and evaluation unit constant. We define the Cross-Lingual Comprehension Gap (CLCG) as the reduction in response quality when the same content and question are presented in a target language rather than in English. Using ParallelQA-18, a professionally human-translated parallel corpus, we evaluate five models from five laboratories on a stratified sample of 150 articles across 18 languages (English reference; Portuguese high-resource baseline; 16 targets spanning Joshi et al. 2020 classes 0-4). A within-item design varies only passage language. The primary estimator contrasts English versus pooled target-language Token-F1 micro-means on higher-complexity open-ended questions, with article-cluster bootstrap intervals. The primary pooled CLCG is 0.078 (95% CI 0.072-0.084), about a 17% reduction relative to the English score; the equal-language macro summary is 0.077. Net of Portuguese, the macro gap is 0.016 (95% CI 0.013-0.020). Language-level CLCG is negatively associated with Joshi resource class (rho = -0.594, p = 0.015, n = 16). In blinded paired human evaluations, higher-resource responses are preferred in 61.6% of decisive judgments (estimated preference probability 0.655, 95% CI 0.558-0.741). Capabilities shown in English should not be assumed to transfer equally to other languages; English-centered evaluations may overestimate quality for users of low-resource languages.
articles.comment: 55 pages, 17 figures. Submitted to Computational Linguistics (MIT Press / ACL). Supplementary Material: 55 pages, 4 figures
articles.titleCn: 测量跨语言理解差距：证据的语言如何塑造语言模型的理解
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型通常被评估时，仿佛在英语中展现的能力在其他语言呈现相同内容时依然同等可用。传统多语言基准很少在保持内容、问题、参考答案、模型和评估单元不变的情况下隔离语言。我们将跨语言理解差距（CLCG）定义为当相同内容和问题以目标语言而非英语呈现时，响应质量下降的程度。使用专业人工翻译的平行语料库ParallelQA-18，我们对来自五个实验室的五个模型在18种语言（英语参考；葡萄牙语高资源基线；16种目标语言涵盖Joshi等2020年分类0-4）的150篇文章的分层样本进行评估。项内设计仅变化段落语言。主要估计器对比英语与目标语言池的Token-F1微观均值，针对高复杂度的开放式问题，并使用文章聚类自举区间。主要池CLCG为0.078（95% CI 0.072-0.084），相对于英语得分减少了约17%；等语言宏观汇总为0.077。排除葡萄牙语后，宏观差距为0.016（95% CI 0.013-0.020）。语言级CLCG与Joshi资源类别呈负相关（rho = -0.594, p = 0.015, n = 16）。在盲法配对人工评估中，高资源响应在61.6%的决断性判断中被偏好（估计偏好概率0.655, 95% CI 0.558-0.741）。英语中展现的能力不应被假设能同等转移到其他语言；以英语为中心的评估可能高估低资源语言用户的响应质量。

articles.title: Can MLLMs Decode the Creative Leap? Introducing C4 for Cross-Concept Understanding
articles.abstract: Creative capabilities of MLLMs matter in design, communication, education, and human--AI collaboration, yet remain difficult to evaluate because explicit targets and reward signals are scarce compared with accuracy-oriented tasks. Cross-concept understanding is a core cognitive capacity underlying receptive creativity. It enables a perceiver to recover intended meaning from non-obvious but meaningful conceptual relations. We operationalize item construction as cross-concept encoding and model inference as cross-concept decoding. We introduce C4, a cognition-inspired evaluation framework for Chengyu (Chinese idiom)-based Cross-Concept Creativity. Its encoding component maps target slots to imageable substitute concepts along bridge paths in a manually annotated and third-party-reviewed cross-concept network, enabling batch generation with explicit structure, difficulty indexed by bridge count and depth, and exact answers. Using this framework, we instantiate the C4 Evaluation Set (C4-Eval), comprising 184 synthetic items and 37 human-created cross-concept chengyu figures collected from online sources. We manually construct and review cross-concept relations, bridge paths, and reasoning processes for the collected figures. Each C4-Eval item is instantiated in five task settings, yielding 884 primary answer-recovery cases. Across ten evaluated MLLMs, the strongest closed models reach 50.7% and 48.0% primary accuracy, while open-source models remain substantially lower. Candidate constraints improve accuracy sharply, but bridge hints and explanation requests provide only modest gains. These results expose a substantial gap in how current MLLMs decode creatively encoded meaning through cross-concept relations. The code is in the supplementary material.
articles.titleCn: MLLMs能否解码创造性飞跃？介绍C4用于跨概念理解
articles.abstractCn: MLLMs的创造力在设计、沟通、教育和人机协作中具有重要意义，但由于与准确性导向任务相比，明确的靶标和奖励信号稀缺，其评估仍然困难。跨概念理解是支撑接受性创造力的核心认知能力。它使感知者能够从非显性但有意义的概念关系中恢复预期含义。我们将项目构建操作化为跨概念编码，将模型推理操作化为跨概念解码。我们引入C4，这是一个受认知启发的、基于成语的跨概念创造力评估框架。其编码组件通过手动标注和第三方评审的跨概念网络中的桥梁路径，将目标槽映射到可视化的替代概念，实现具有明确结构、难度由桥梁数量和深度索引、以及精确答案的批量生成。使用该框架，我们实例化了C4评估集（C4-Eval），其中包含184个合成项目和从网络资源收集的37个人类创建的跨概念成语图形。我们手动构建和评审了收集到的图形的跨概念关系、桥梁路径和推理过程。每个C4-Eval项目在五个任务设置中实例化，产生884个初级答案恢复案例。在十个评估的MLLMs中，最强的封闭模型达到50.7%和48.0%的初级准确率，而开源模型仍然显著较低。候选约束显著提高了准确率，但桥梁提示和解释请求仅提供了适度的提升。这些结果揭示了当前MLLMs通过跨概念关系解码创造性编码含义时存在的巨大差距。代码在补充材料中。

articles.title: ConstructCIE: A Dataset for Extracting Causal Information from Construction Accident Narratives
articles.abstract: Construction accident narratives contain rich causal information, but the evidence is often implicit, long-span, and distributed. We introduce ConstructCIE, a manually annotated dataset for Causal Information Extraction from OSHA construction accident reports. The dataset uses a hierarchical schema for accident types, causal factors, sub-causal factors, and supporting evidence spans. We evaluate supervised sequence taggers and instruction-tuned LLMs in an end-to-end hierarchical extraction setting. Results show that most evaluated models achieve strong accident-type prediction and recover broad causal meaning but remain limited in precise span-level extraction. JHE generally achieves stronger exact and soft matching, while IHE sometimes achieves higher keyword F1. Error distributions vary by extraction strategy, but evidence-selection and span-boundary errors remain common. These findings show that reliable Causal Information Extraction for construction accidents requires stronger domain grounding and more accurate evidence extraction.
articles.titleCn: ConstructCIE：一个从建筑事故叙述中提取因果信息的数据库
articles.abstractCn: 建筑事故叙述包含丰富的因果信息，但证据通常隐含、跨越时间长且分散。我们引入了ConstructCIE，这是一个用于从OSHA建筑事故报告中提取因果信息的、经过人工标注的数据集。该数据集采用分层架构来组织事故类型、因果因素、子因果因素和支撑证据片段。我们在端到端的分层提取设置中评估了监督序列标注器和指令微调的大型语言模型。结果表明，大多数评估模型在事故类型预测上表现强劲，并能恢复广泛的因果意义，但在精确的片段级提取方面仍存在局限。JHE通常在精确匹配和软匹配上表现更强，而IHE有时在关键词F1上表现更高。错误分布因提取策略而异，但证据选择和片段边界错误仍然普遍存在。这些发现表明，要实现可靠的建筑事故因果信息提取，需要更强的领域基础和更精确的证据提取能力。

articles.title: Do AI Personas Grow? Analyzing and Benchmarking Personality Evolution in LLM Agents After Life Events
articles.abstract: Personality-conditioned LLM agents (PC-Agents) are increasingly used in emotional support, social simulation, and role-playing, motivating the development of lifelong agents that remain coherent over extended interactions. A key component of such coherence is personality evolution: agents should undergo plausible, psychology-grounded changes as they experience life events in different contexts. Although prior work shows that LLM personalities can shift under contextual perturbations, how these shifts vary across traits, events, personas, and models remains poorly understood. We study event-induced personality change after 11 major life events, using the Big Five traits as a psychometric anchor and interpreting the resulting trajectories against longitudinal evidence from human personality psychology. Across four diagnostic axes, PC-Agents exhibit measurable trait shifts at similar rates for event-trait pairs with and without documented human change directions. Even when shifts follow the expected direction, their magnitudes usually fall below human effect-size ranges. Gender and cultural-region prompts show little moderating effect, while persona-level dispersion is compressed three- to four-fold relative to human samples. To enable systematic comparison, we introduce BFI-Adapt, a reusable benchmark for scoring the directional fidelity of event-induced personality change, and use it to rank 14 models. A validation suite shows that the measured shifts exceed no-event retest noise, remain stable under independently paraphrased prompts, exhibit limited and model-dependent convergence with scenario-based behavioral choices, and persist across intervening unrelated dialogue. Together, these checks establish the measured trajectories as robust event-conditioned response patterns. Our results suggest that current PC-Agents simulate the mean of human personality dynamics, but not its shape.
articles.titleCn: AI角色会成长吗？分析并基准测试LLM代理在经历生活事件后的性格演变
articles.abstractCn: 基于性格的LLM代理（PC-Agents）在情感支持、社交模拟和角色扮演中的应用日益增多，这推动了终身代理的发展，使其在长时间交互中保持一致性。这种一致性的关键组成部分是性格进化：代理应在不同情境下经历生活事件时，经历合理且基于心理学的变化。尽管已有研究表明LLM的性格可以在情境扰动下发生变化，但这些变化如何在不同特质、事件、角色和模型之间差异，仍缺乏了解。我们研究了经历11件主要生活事件后的性格变化，以“大五人格”特质作为心理测量基准，并将结果轨迹与人类性格心理学中的纵向证据进行对比。在四个诊断轴上，PC-Agents在具有和缺乏人类变化方向记录的事件-特质对中，表现出相似速率的可测量特质变化。即使变化遵循预期方向，其幅度通常也低于人类效应范围。性别和文化区域提示显示出微弱的调节效应，而角色层面的分散程度相对于人类样本压缩了三到四倍。为了进行系统比较，我们引入了BFI-Adapt，一个用于评分事件诱导性格变化方向保真度的可重用基准，并使用它对14个模型进行排名。一个验证套件表明，测量的变化超出了无事件重测噪声，在独立改写的提示下保持稳定，与基于场景的行为选择表现出有限且模型相关的收敛，并在无关对话的干预期间持续存在。这些检查共同确立了测量的轨迹为稳健的事件条件响应模式。我们的结果表明，当前的PC-Agents模拟的是人类性格动态的平均值，而非其形状。

articles.title: StepJack: Benchmarking Computer-Use Agent Safety Against Multi-Step Indirect Prompt Injection
articles.abstract: Computer-use agents (CUAs) face a growing threat from indirect prompt injection, where adversarial instructions are planted in the environment such as web pages. In this paper, we introduce multi-step indirect prompt injection, a new attack class against CUAs in which the adversarial goal is decomposed into multiple innocuous-looking sub-steps and distributed across a chain of pages referenced along the agent's navigation path. We develop a pipeline to automatically decompose an adversarial goal under the constraint that the execution of the decomposed sub-steps must achieve the original goal while optimizing the innocuousness of each decomposed sub-step. With this pipeline, we build StepJack, a CUA safety benchmark with 480 test examples. On this benchmark, we evaluate six state-of-the-art CUAs and find that at a fixed decomposition depth, multi-step attacks raise attack success rate (ASR) on three of six CUAs, by up to 31.2 points (e.g., GPT-5.4-mini: 41.7% at single-step to 72.9% at three-step); averaged over the five CUAs that can reliably follow the reference chain (all but EvoCUA-32B), ASR rises from 31.3% at single-step to 36.9% at three-step. Dataset and code are available at https://github.com/BorealisAI/StepJack.
articles.titleCn: StepJack：针对多步间接提示注入，对计算机使用代理安全进行基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 计算机使用代理（CUA）正面临日益增长的间接提示注入威胁，其中对抗性指令被植入环境，如网页中。在本文中，我们引入了多步间接提示注入，这是一种针对CUA的新型攻击类别，其中对抗性目标被分解为多个看似无害的子步骤，并分布在整个代理导航路径中引用的页面链中。我们开发了一个管道，用于自动分解对抗性目标，约束条件是分解的子步骤的执行必须实现原始目标，同时优化每个分解子步骤的无害性。通过该管道，我们构建了StepJack，一个包含480个测试用例的CUA安全基准。在这个基准上，我们评估了六种最先进的CUA，发现对于三种CUA，在固定的分解深度下，多步攻击将攻击成功率（ASR）提高了高达31.2个百分点（例如，GPT-5.4-mini：单步41.7%到三步72.9%）；对于能够可靠地遵循引用链的五种CUA（除EvoCUA-32B外），ASR从单步31.3%上升到三步36.9%。数据集和代码可在https://github.com/BorealisAI/StepJack获取。

articles.title: Learning When to Trust via Selective Context Preference Optimization
articles.abstract: Language models increasingly condition their answers on external signals, and a single misleading one can turn a correct answer wrong. The obvious remedy, training models to resist such signals, hides a failure mode: a model that ignores all context looks robust yet is useless when the context is worth trusting. We recast the problem as selective trust and introduce MIST, a human-annotated benchmark that renders each reasoning item under four matched conditions (clean, misleading, correct-context, and irrelevant-context), together with SC2W, a paired metric counting how often a misleading signal flips a clean-correct answer to wrong. Across a comprehensive benchmark study, we observe that such a susceptibility is universal. We then propose SCOPE, which mines clean-correct/misleading-wrong failures and optimizes a standard Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) objective over matched preference pairs balanced equally across all four conditions, rather than over misleading items alone. Our approach substantially reduces SC2W on popular open-sourced models while preserving accuracy when the added context is clean, correct, or irrelevant. With this work, we argue that models should be judged on selective trust, not on resistance alone.

articles.titleCn: 通过选择性上下文偏好优化学习何时信任
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型越来越多地根据外部信号来调整它们的答案，而一个误导性的信号就可能导致正确答案变成错误答案。显而易见的补救措施是训练模型来抵抗这类信号，但这背后隐藏着一个失效模式：一个完全忽略所有上下文的模型看起来很稳健，但在上下文值得信任时却毫无用处。我们将问题重新定义为选择性信任，并引入了MIST，这是一个人类标注的基准，它将每个推理项目在四种匹配条件下（干净、误导性、正确上下文和无关上下文）进行呈现，以及SC2W，这是一个配对指标，用于计算误导性信号将干净正确答案翻转成错误答案的频率。在全面基准研究后，我们观察到这种易感性是普遍存在的。然后我们提出了SCOPE，它挖掘干净正确/误导性错误失效情况，并在所有四种条件下平衡匹配偏好对上优化标准的直接偏好优化（DPO）目标，而不是单独在误导性项目上优化。我们的方法在流行的开源模型上显著降低了SC2W，同时在添加的上下文是干净、正确或无关时保持了准确性。通过这项工作，我们主张模型的评价应该基于选择性信任，而不仅仅是抵抗能力。

articles.title: The Bitter Lesson of Tool Calling
articles.abstract: Tool use transforms LLMs into agents that act beyond their training data, and for code-capable models, programmatic tool calling extends this further by replacing rigid JSON calls with scripts that chain and parallelize naturally. However, a systematic evaluation of tools as code on an established benchmark across current and prior model generations under real-world task conditions has not been conducted. In this work, we empirically compare programmatic tool calling (PTC) to native JSON tool calling across 14 language models on BFCL v4. In the programmatic tool calling paradigm, tools are exposed as typed Python stubs that the model invokes through code, with execution and results handled in a single agent turn. Programmatic tool calling matches or exceeds native JSON tool calling in 11 of 14 models on BFCL v4, with the GPT-5.6 family achieving a 10.6% improvement over the JSON tool calling baseline. Further, it matches or outperforms baseline in 13 of 14 models under parallel fan-out, and holds stable under context rot conditions where baseline degrades 2.3% on average. Our results demonstrate that programmatic tool calling is a viable and robust alternative to JSON tool calling, with performance tracking model capability across release generations.
articles.titleCn: 工具调用的苦涩教训
articles.abstractCn: 工具使用将大型语言模型转化为超越其训练数据的智能体，而对于具备代码能力的模型，程序化工具调用通过将僵化的JSON调用替换为自然地串联和并行化脚本，进一步扩展了这一能力。然而，在真实任务条件下，针对当前及先前模型代在既定基准上对工具作为代码进行系统性评估尚未进行。在本工作中，我们在BFCL v4上对14种语言模型的程序化工具调用（PTC）与原生JSON工具调用进行了实证比较。在程序化工具调用范式中，工具被暴露为模型通过代码调用的类型化Python存根，执行和结果在单个智能体回合中处理。在BFCL v4上，程序化工具调用在11种模型中与原生JSON工具调用相当或超越，GPT-5.6系列在JSON工具调用基准上实现了10.6%的改进。此外，在并行扩展条件下，它在14种模型中的13种与基准相当或表现更优，并在上下文旋转条件下保持稳定，而基准平均退化2.3%。我们的结果表明，程序化工具调用是JSON工具调用的可行且稳健的替代方案，其性能与模型能力随版本发布的进展相匹配。

articles.title: AV-AIVAT: 74x Cheaper Agent Evaluation with Certified Anytime-Valid Stopping in Imperfect-Information Games
articles.abstract: Deciding which of two agents is stronger means playing games until skill outweighs luck, and every game costs money, model inference, or expert time. Since the number of games needed is unknown, fixed-budget evaluations either keep paying after the result is settled or stop before the agents can be told apart, while naive optional stopping with an ordinary confidence interval invalidates the stated level. We make such an evaluation stop as soon as its evidence suffices, with the guarantee intact. The Action-Informed Value Assessment Tool (AIVAT) reduces variance in imperfect-information games through conditional mean-zero corrections, by a median $54\times$ across 15 LLM agent configurations spanning 71,439 paired Heads-Up No-Limit Hold'em (HUNL) hands, but does not say when to stop. We combine AIVAT with continuously monitored Confidence Sequences (CSs) into anytime-valid AIVAT (AV-AIVAT), whose online value model learns only from past games so that no game scores its own correction. At the nominal 95\% level and a target precision of $\pm1$ Big Blind, raw outcomes need a median $74\times$ as many hands as AIVAT-corrected outcomes to stop under the Asymptotic CS (AsympCS). Exact finite-sample certification uses the Empirical-Bernstein CS (EB-CS), which needs an independently justified bound on corrected payoffs. We establish such a bound structurally for Leduc hold'em and characterize a width floor set by the CS's bet cap and that bound, which governs how much of a variance gain becomes earlier stopping; the descriptive HUNL EB-CS runs show a median $1.37\times$ stopping-time ratio. AV-AIVAT turns variance reduction into efficient, auditable early stopping while separating asymptotic screening from exact certification, so an evaluation can stop the moment its evidence suffices and hand a third party everything needed to recheck the verdict at that very stopping time.
articles.titleCn: AV-AIVAT：在信息不完美游戏中以74倍的成本降低代理评估，并具有随时有效的认证停止
articles.abstractCn: 判断两个智能体哪个更强意味着通过玩游戏直到技能超过运气，而每场游戏都需要花费金钱、模型推理或专家时间。由于所需游戏数量未知，固定预算评估要么在结果确定后继续支付，要么在无法区分智能体之前停止，而普通的置信区间下的朴素可选停止会使所声称的置信水平失效。我们让这种评估在证据足够时立即停止，同时保持保证不变。行动指导价值评估工具（AIVAT）通过条件均值零校正减少信息不完美游戏中的方差，在跨越71,439对Heads-Up No-Limit Hold'em（HUNL）手的15个LLM智能体配置中，中位数为54倍，但并未说明何时停止。我们将AIVAT与持续监控的置信序列（CSs）结合，形成随时有效的AIVAT（AV-AIVAT），其在线价值模型仅从过去的游戏中学习，因此没有游戏会对自己进行校正。在名义95%水平和目标精度为±1大底注下，原始结果需要74倍于AIVAT校正结果的对数来在渐近CS（AsympCS）下停止。精确有限样本认证使用经验Bernstein CS（EB-CS），它需要一个独立证明的校正收益界限。我们为Leduc hold'em结构地建立这种界限，并描述了由CS的投注上限和该界限决定的宽度下限，这决定了多少方差增益转化为早期停止；描述性的HUNL EB-CS运行显示中位数为1.37倍的停止时间比率。AV-AIVAT将方差减少转化为高效、可审计的早期停止，同时将渐近筛选与精确认证分离，因此评估可以在证据足够时立即停止，并将所有必要信息交给第三方在那一刻重新检查判决。

articles.title: CalibForge: Adversarial Solver Calibration for Scaling Learnable Terminal Tasks
articles.abstract: Training terminal agents requires executable and verifiable tasks that are not merely solvable, but appropriately challenging for learning. Executable validation establishes feasibility, yet does not reveal how a task behaves relative to a given solver setting. In this paper, we present CalibForge, an autonomous terminal-task synthesis system that uses verified solver behavior to revise candidate tasks through adversarial solver calibration. Multi-solver calibration targets disagreement within a heterogeneous solver pool, whereas contrastive solver calibration targets a designated strong-pass/weak-fail relation; both operationalize a solver-relative learnable zone anchored in demonstrated solvability. Using CalibForge, we construct 5,431 calibrated terminal tasks. Our ablations show that both strategies yield more effective supervision than authoring and validation alone or ordinary single-solver feedback. Models trained on the full collection achieve 32.58% and 47.57% on Terminal-Bench 2.0. The largest improvements over the corresponding base model reach 24.71 percentage points on Terminal-Bench 2.0, 27.68 points on SWE-bench Pro, and 30.04 points on Doc2Repo. Together, these results support solver-relative learnability as a practical target for constructing effective and transferable agent training data.
articles.titleCn: CalibForge：对抗求解器校准用于扩展可学习终端任务
articles.abstractCn: 训练终端代理需要可执行且可验证的任务，这些任务不仅可解，而且要适合学习。可执行性验证确立了可行性，但并未揭示任务相对于特定求解器设置的行为。在本文中，我们提出了CalibForge，一个自主的终端任务合成系统，该系统利用已验证的求解器行为通过对抗性求解器校准来修订候选任务。多求解器校准针对异构求解器池中的分歧，而对比求解器校准针对指定的强通过/弱失败关系；两者都实现了一个以已证明的可解性为基础的、与求解器相关的可学习区域。使用CalibForge，我们构建了5,431个校准的终端任务。我们的消融实验表明，这两种策略比单独的编写和验证或普通的单求解器反馈提供更有效的监督。在完整数据集上训练的模型在Terminal-Bench 2.0上达到了32.58%和47.57%的成绩。相对于相应的基线模型，最大的改进在Terminal-Bench 2.0上达到了24.71个百分点，在SWE-bench Pro上达到了27.68个百分点，在Doc2Repo上达到了30.04个百分点。这些结果共同支持了求解器相关的可学习性作为构建有效且可迁移的代理训练数据的实用目标。

articles.title: RP-OPSD: Reasoning-Pivot-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation for Multilingual Reasoning Transfer
articles.abstract: Multilingual reasoning transfer is crucial for extending reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) beyond high-resource languages. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) and its variants have emerged as a promising paradigm, providing dense token-level supervision on student-generated rollouts, yet their objectives do not explicitly prioritize reasoning signals most critical to cross-lingual transfer. We characterize that target-language reasoning comprises the generation of both surface text and reasoning pivots, which are decisions that advance or redirect the reasoning process and shape subsequent inference. This motivates concentrating privileged distillation around such pivots. We therefore propose RP-OPSD, Reasoning-Pivot-guided On-Policy Self-Distillation, using the distributional shift between matched teacher views with and without an English reference solution as an operational proxy to guide privileged distillation and reference anchoring. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks covering 17 languages and multiple difficulty levels show that our method outperforms strong multilingual reasoning baselines and OPSD variants. Further analysis reveals that RP-OPSD concentrates privileged distillation on reasoning-control and problem-condistioned state-update tokens, while downweighting it for tokens that mainly support surface realization. Our code is available at https://github.com/NJUNLP/RP-OPSD.
articles.titleCn: RP-OPSD：推理枢轴引导的在线策略自蒸馏方法，用于多语言推理迁移
articles.abstractCn: 多语言推理迁移对于扩展大型语言模型（LLM）在资源丰富的语言之外的推理能力至关重要。策略内自蒸馏（OPSD）及其变体已成为一种有前景的范式，为教师生成的推理过程提供密集的标记级监督，但它们的优化目标并未明确优先考虑对跨语言迁移最关键的推理信号。我们指出，目标语言的推理包含表面文本的生成和推理枢轴的生成，推理枢轴是推进或重定向推理过程并塑造后续推理的决策。这促使我们将特权蒸馏集中在这些枢轴上。因此，我们提出了RP-OPSD，即推理枢轴引导的策略内自蒸馏，利用匹配的教师视图在包含和不包含英语参考解之间的分布偏移作为操作代理来指导特权蒸馏和参考锚定。在涵盖17种语言和多个难度级别的数学推理基准上的实验表明，我们的方法优于强大的多语言推理基线和OPSD变体。进一步分析揭示，RP-OPSD将特权蒸馏集中在推理控制和问题条件状态更新的标记上，同时降低对主要支持表面实现的标记的权重。我们的代码可在https://github.com/NJUNLP/RP-OPSD获取。

articles.title: Benchmarking the Benchmarks: Evaluating Benchmarks for Conversational Agents
articles.abstract: Task-oriented conversational agents are evaluated using curated or automatically generated benchmarks, yet benchmark quality is rarely assessed. Poor benchmarks may contain inconsistent tasks, simplistic scenarios, or limited policy coverage, leading to unreliable evaluations. We introduce a reference-free framework that uses LLM judges to assess benchmark consistency, complexity, and policy coverage, while providing actionable diagnostics of weaknesses. We validate the framework by demonstrating agreement with independent human annotations and by evaluating benchmarks generated by LLMs of varying capabilities, as well as benchmarks subjected to controlled quality-degrading perturbations. Across domains and judge models, the proposed metrics consistently distinguish between benchmark quality levels. We further demonstrate the framework's applicability to manually curated benchmarks. Our framework offers a practical approach for evaluating synthetic and manually curated conversational-agent benchmarks.
articles.titleCn: 基准测试基准：评估对话代理的基准
articles.abstractCn: 面向任务的对话代理通常使用精选或自动生成的基准进行评估，但基准质量很少被评估。质量差的基准可能包含不一致的任务、简单的场景或有限的政策覆盖范围，导致评估结果不可靠。我们引入了一种无需参考的框架，该框架使用大型语言模型（LLM）裁判来评估基准的一致性、复杂性和政策覆盖范围，同时提供关于弱点的可操作诊断。我们通过证明该框架与独立人工标注的一致性，以及评估由不同能力的大型语言模型生成和经过受控质量退化扰动处理的基准，来验证该框架。在各个领域和裁判模型中，所提出的指标始终能够区分基准质量水平。我们进一步展示了该框架适用于人工精选基准。我们的框架为评估合成和人工精选的对话代理基准提供了一种实用方法。

articles.title: Benchmarking and Enhancing LLMs for Rule-Intensive Review of National Standard Documents
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly support complex professional tasks, yet their capabilities in rule-intensive document review remain insufficiently evaluated. National standard documents, such as China GB/T standards, offer a representative testbed: they are lengthy, highly structured, and governed by explicit rules for scope, terminology, normative wording, and cross-section consistency. Existing benchmarks focus on domain knowledge and question answering, largely overlooking intrinsic quality review for professional documents. Such reviews rely heavily on human experts, making them costly and difficult to scale. To bridge this gap, we introduce GB/T-Bench, the first benchmark for the structured review of national standard documents. Its GB/T Review Taxonomy is a hierarchical schema covering document structure, scope alignment, normative modality, terminology consistency, and normative references, with 25 diagnosable error types. A controllable counterexample generation mechanism combines deterministic rules and constrained LLM rewriting to process 488 documents into 7,306 traceable review error instances for evaluation. We also develop a diagnosis-oriented evaluation protocol requiring exact matches on error location, review dimension, and error type, plus document-level coverage metrics. We further propose GB/T-Reviewer, a multi-agent framework that converts review knowledge into specialized skills and coordinates global inspection, targeted diagnosis, rule scanning, and result verification. Experiments with 14 mainstream LLMs reveal a substantial human-LLM gap: the strongest model achieves only 0.3280 CMCS versus 0.6640 for experts. GB/T-Reviewer raises the best CMCS to 0.5094, showing the value of structured skill coordination for rule-intensive document review. This work paves the way for trustworthy AI in standardization and other high-stakes document domains.
articles.titleCn: 针对国家标准文件进行规则密集型审查的LLM基准测试与优化
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地支持复杂的职业任务，但它们在规则密集型文档审查方面的能力仍缺乏充分评估。国家标准文件，如中国的GB/T标准，提供了一个有代表性的测试平台：它们篇幅长、结构高度严谨，并遵循明确的范围、术语、规范性措辞和截面一致性规则。现有基准主要关注领域知识和问答，很大程度上忽略了专业文档的内在质量审查。此类审查严重依赖人类专家，因此成本高昂且难以规模化。为弥补这一差距，我们引入了GB/T-Bench，这是首个用于国家标准文件结构化审查的基准。其GB/T审查分类法是一个分层架构，涵盖文档结构、范围一致性、规范性模式、术语一致性和规范性引用，包含25种可诊断的错误类型。可控的反例生成机制结合确定性规则和约束LLM重写，将488份文档处理成7306个可追溯的审查错误实例用于评估。我们还开发了一个以诊断为导向的评估协议，要求在错误位置、审查维度和错误类型上实现精确匹配，并加上文档级覆盖率指标。我们进一步提出了GB/T-Reviewer，这是一个多智能体框架，将审查知识转化为专业技能，并协调全局检查、针对性诊断、规则扫描和结果验证。对14个主流LLM的实验揭示了一个显著的人机差距：最强模型仅达到0.3280的CMCS，而专家则为0.6640。GB/T-Reviewer将最佳CMCS提高到0.5094，显示了结构化技能协调在规则密集型文档审查中的价值。这项工作为标准化及其他高风险文档领域中的可信人工智能铺平了道路。

articles.title: RRC: Unlocking Generative Reward Models in LLM Reinforcement Learning via Ranking-Based Reward Construction
articles.abstract: Recent advances in reward modeling show a paradigm shift from discriminative reward models to generative reward models. However, despite their strong capabilities in response ranking, generative reward models have not realized their potential in reinforcement learning (RL). Our analysis reveals that this limitation arises from a mismatch between the comparative nature of generative reward modeling and the scalar scoring paradigm adopted by existing RL algorithms. To bridge this gap, we propose a Ranking-based Reward Construction (RRC) approach, which enables generative reward models to provide more effective RL learning signals by deriving rewards from relative preference rankings. RRC introduces two complementary strategies: self-competitive ranking, which exploits comparisons among sampled responses, and anchor-guided ranking, which enables scalable ranking-based reward construction with a small set of reference responses. Experiments across open-ended chat and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that RRC substantially improves RL training with generative reward models, achieving consistent gains over existing reward construction approaches. Our code can be found at https://github.com/wangclnlp/RRC.
articles.titleCn: RRC：基于排名的奖励构建，通过排名机制解锁大型语言模型强化学习中的生成式奖励模型
articles.abstractCn: 近期在奖励建模领域的进展显示了一种范式转变，从判别式奖励模型转向生成式奖励模型。然而，尽管生成式奖励模型在响应排序方面具有强大能力，它们在强化学习（RL）中尚未实现其潜力。我们的分析揭示，这一局限性源于生成式奖励建模的比较性质与现有RL算法采用的标量评分范式之间的不匹配。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了基于排序的奖励构建（RRC）方法，该方法通过从相对偏好排序中导出奖励，使生成式奖励模型能够提供更有效的RL学习信号。RRC引入了两种互补策略：自我竞争排序，该策略利用采样响应之间的比较；锚点引导排序，该策略通过少量参考响应实现可扩展的基于排序的奖励构建。在开放式聊天和推理基准测试中的实验表明，RRC显著提高了使用生成式奖励模型的RL训练效果，并在现有的奖励构建方法上实现了持续的提升。我们的代码可以在 https://github.com/wangclnlp/RRC 找到。

articles.title: Beyond Top-K: Replacing Black-Box Retrieval with Interpretable Agentic Operations
articles.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation over long documents is dominated by one design: chunk the text, embed the chunks, and surface the top-k nearest neighbours of the query. We argue that for an important class of documents -- financial statements, audit reports, regulatory returns -- this design is structurally unsound, and we make the argument measurable. On a 780-page government financial report, 86.8% of content lines are table rows, thousands of near-identical figures compete in one embedding space, and a figure inherits its unit from a header a median of 13 lines above it -- so a chunk boundary routinely separates a number from whether it is in lakh or crore, an error of two orders of magnitude. A table-aware chunker built as a steelman fixes the unit problem but leaves 27-30% of numeric chunks with no fiscal-year header at every chunk size we tried. We propose READ (Reliable Embedding-free Agentic Document-search), in which an agent reads the raw document through three deterministic operations -- normalized lexical search, structural navigation, and bounded span reads -- exposed over the Model Context Protocol, so a trajectory is a replayable audit trail, not an opaque similarity score. On 51 verified questions READ answers 58.8% against dense retrieval's 15.7% (p_Holm = 2 x 10^-5) -- or 35.3% tuned, which READ still leads by 23.5 points (p_Holm = 0.017). An agent given the same loop but a top-k tool reaches only 27.5%, locating the gain in the interface rather than in iteration. We also report what the evidence does not support: BM25 is statistically indistinguishable from READ, so our result separates embedding-based from embedding-free retrieval, not agentic from lexical search.
articles.comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, 14 tables. Code, benchmark, and full result trajectories: https://github.com/twospoon/READ
articles.titleCn: 超越Top-K：用可解释的代理操作替代黑盒检索
articles.abstractCn: 针对长文档的检索增强生成主要采用一种设计：将文本分块，嵌入这些块，并提取查询的top-k最近邻。我们认为对于一类重要文档——财务报表、审计报告、监管报告——这种设计在结构上存在缺陷，并且我们使这一论点可衡量。在一份780页的政府财务报告中，86.8%的内容行是表格行，成千上万的相似数字在嵌入空间中竞争，一个数字从它上方中位数为13行的标题中继承单位——因此一个分块边界通常将一个数字与其是十万元还是百万元分开，这是一个数量级上的错误。我们构建了一个表格感知分块器作为钢强解决方案，它解决了单位问题，但在我们尝试的每种分块大小下，仍有27-30%的数字块没有财政年度标题。我们提出了READ（无可靠嵌入的代理文档搜索），其中代理通过三个确定性操作——标准化词汇搜索、结构导航和有界跨度读取——读取原始文档，这些操作通过模型上下文协议暴露，因此轨迹是一个可重放的审计追踪，而不是一个不透明的相似度分数。在51个验证问题中，READ回答了58.8%，而密集检索仅回答了15.7%（p_Holm = 2 x 10^-5）——或者经过调整的35.3%，READ仍然领先23.5分（p_Holm = 0.017）。一个被赋予相同循环但使用top-k工具的代理仅达到27.5%，其进步体现在界面而非迭代中。我们还报告了证据不支持的内容：BM25在统计上与READ无区别，因此我们的结果区分了基于嵌入和基于无嵌入的检索，而非代理检索与词汇搜索。

articles.title: HarnessOpt-Bench: Evaluating LLMs at Harness Optimization
articles.abstract: As LLMs are increasingly deployed within agentic systems, their capabilities depend not only on the model weights but also on the harness: the prompts, tools, control flow, memory, and orchestration code surrounding them. This makes automated harness optimization -- the iterative and evaluation-guided improvement of a harness by an AI system -- both an important route to improving AI systems and a demanding capability for AI systems themselves. Yet the community lacks a common protocol for measuring how well frontier LLMs perform at this task. We introduce HarnessOpt-Bench, a benchmark for end-to-end harness optimization under expensive and stochastic evaluation. An optimizer, an LLM paired with a coding harness, receives a target agent's seed harness, graded evaluation feedback, and a fixed target-evaluation budget. It edits the harness and nominates a final candidate, which is scored by its normalized gain over the seed on a held-out test partition that remains inaccessible throughout search. A trusted execution environment enforces the evaluation boundary, meters target-agent resource use, and preserves candidate versions for audit. We evaluate 5 frontier LLMs as optimizers both under a shared coding harness and under their native harnesses across 4 downstream tasks, over 111 scored runs. Experiment results show that optimizer models separate more than the coding harnesses they act through, native harnesses are not consistently superior, and gains vary substantially across tasks and seed regimes. These results establish harness optimization as a measurable and discriminative capability with large space for improvement.
articles.titleCn: HarnessOpt-Bench：评估在Harness优化中的大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 随着大语言模型越来越多地部署在自主系统中，其能力不仅取决于模型权重，还取决于其应用环境：包括提示、工具、控制流程、记忆和编排代码。这使得自动化应用环境优化——即由人工智能系统通过迭代和评估指导来改进应用环境——既成为改进人工智能系统的重要途径，也对人工智能系统本身提出了高要求。然而，社区缺乏一个通用的协议来衡量前沿大语言模型在这一任务上的表现。我们介绍了HarnessOpt-Bench，这是一个用于昂贵且随机评估下的端到端应用环境优化的基准测试。优化器（一个与编码应用环境配对的大语言模型）接收目标代理的初始应用环境、分级评估反馈以及固定的目标评估预算。它会编辑应用环境并提名一个最终候选方案，该候选方案在搜索过程中始终保持不可访问的测试分区上对其初始方案进行归一化增益评分。一个可信的执行环境强制执行评估边界，计量目标代理资源使用情况，并保留候选方案版本以供审计。我们在4个下游任务中，通过共享编码应用环境和各自的原生应用环境，对5个前沿大语言模型作为优化器进行了111次评分运行的评价。实验结果表明，优化器模型与其作用的应用环境相比具有更大的区分度，原生应用环境并不始终更优越，且增益在不同任务和初始方案环境下差异显著。这些结果确立了应用环境优化是一项可衡量且具有显著区分度的能力，并存在巨大的改进空间。

articles.title: NeSy-RAG: Neuro-Symbolic RAG for Explainable Question Answering
articles.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves question answering by grounding large language models (LLMs) in external knowledge such as text corpora. However, its reasoning process remains largely opaque: intermediate reasoning steps are difficult to verify and cannot be reliably attributed to specific evidence. Moreover, missing user-specific context is rarely detected systematically, often leading to incomplete or incorrect output. We propose NeSy-RAG, a modular neuro-symbolic RAG framework that synthesizes attributable Prolog modules from retrieved text chunks. For each chunk, the system generates semantically meaningful predicates that encode Boolean claims, which may depend on user facts. Using joint natural language-code embeddings, predicates are retrieved and composed into Prolog queries. To address incomplete user context, we introduce a symbolic knowledge-gap detection mechanism that identifies missing user facts whose truth values affect the query outcome and automatically triggers follow-up interactions. Executing the resulting Prolog queries yields deterministic answers together with transparent execution traces that link each reasoning step to its originating source. On the ShARC benchmark, without domain-specific training, NeSy-RAG achieves 61.1% accuracy, outperforming a same-model RAG baseline that achieves 42.8% accuracy.
articles.titleCn: NeSy-RAG：用于可解释问答的神经符号RAG
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过将大型语言模型（LLM）与外部知识（如文本语料库）相结合来提升问答能力。然而，其推理过程仍然很大程度上不透明：中间推理步骤难以验证，且无法可靠地归因于特定证据。此外，用户特定上下文的缺失很少被系统性地检测到，这往往导致输出不完整或错误。我们提出了NeSy-RAG，这是一个模块化神经符号RAG框架，该框架从检索到的文本块中合成可归因的Prolog模块。对于每个文本块，系统会生成具有语义意义的谓词，这些谓词编码了布尔声明，可能依赖于用户事实。通过联合自然语言-代码嵌入，谓词被检索并组合成Prolog查询。为了解决用户上下文不完整的问题，我们引入了一种符号知识缺口检测机制，该机制识别那些其真值会影响查询结果而缺失的用户事实，并自动触发后续交互。执行生成的Prolog查询可得到确定性答案，并提供透明的执行轨迹，将每个推理步骤与其来源关联起来。在ShARC基准测试中，NeSy-RAG在不进行领域特定训练的情况下，达到了61.1%的准确率，优于实现了42.8%准确率的相同模型RAG基线。

articles.title: OpenPM: Auditable Point-in-Time Evaluation for LLM Portfolio-Management Agents
articles.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to read markets, assess risk, and allocate capital. However, reported results for LLM trading agents can be inflated by look-ahead leakage, optimistic execution, and risk mandates that are described but not enforced. We present OpenPM, an auditable point-in-time evaluation framework for LLM portfolio-management agents. In OpenPM, an agent manages a \$1M long-only book over the S\&P 500 universe using market data at five-minute intervals. Every record visible to the agent must be available at the decision time. Natural-language risk mandates are converted into typed constraints and enforced on the executed portfolio. Each run produces audit artifacts, including a contamination certificate, a cost-sensitivity curve, and a constraint-adherence report. We also build a reference agent named the tiered allocator, where typed analysts score candidates, a constructor LLM proposes weights, and a deterministic critic guarantees feasibility. We isolate constructor behavior by capturing analyst evidence once and replaying it across constructor models. In our short-window case study, stronger constructors show modest and model-dependent gains over equal weighting on the same pool, but analyst quality matters more than constructor choice, and turnover is the main cost driver. All returns are upper bounds on a single frozen window without market impact, not validated alpha.
articles.titleCn: OpenPM：用于LLM投资组合管理代理的可审计即时评估
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型正越来越多地用于分析市场、评估风险和配置资本。然而，据报道的LLM交易代理的结果可能因提前泄露、乐观执行以及描述但未强制执行的风险指令而被夸大。我们提出了OpenPM，这是一个用于LLM投资组合管理代理的可审计即时评估框架。在OpenPM中，代理使用五分钟间隔的市场数据管理价值100万美元的仅做多投资组合，涵盖标普500指数。代理可见的每条记录必须在决策时可用。自然语言风险指令被转换为类型化约束，并在执行的投资组合上强制执行。每次运行都会生成审计工件，包括污染证明、成本敏感性曲线和约束遵守报告。我们还构建了一个名为分层分配器的参考代理，其中类型化分析师对候选对象进行评分，构造性LLM提出权重，确定性评论家保证可行性。我们通过捕获分析师证据一次并在构造性模型中重放来隔离构造行为。在我们的短期窗口案例研究中，更强的构造性模型在同一池上显示出适度且模型相关的收益，但分析师质量比构造性选择更重要，而换手率是主要成本驱动因素。所有回报都是未经市场影响的单个冻结窗口的上限，并非经过验证的alpha。

articles.title: Routing Is Least Learnable Where It Is Most Valuable: Bounds on Representation Routing for Web Agents
articles.abstract: Web agents observe a browser through text, pixels, or both, and the choice is usually fixed once for all tasks. We measure six observation modes across eight site-model combinations (cells) on VisualWebArena and WebArena and ask what choosing per task would buy. The modes are complementary: each solves tasks the others miss, they fail in structurally different ways, and the best choice reverses between task sets. The obvious prize, an oracle that picks a winning mode for every task, looks large but is inflated by run-to-run noise: rerunning the same mode on the same tasks changes 12-14% of outcomes, so a second run of a mode already in hand gains about as much as adding a new one. What survives is a cost bound: sending only the tasks no mode solves to the cheapest mode cuts cost by 9.5-30.6% in 8 of 8 cells at unchanged success. We then test five routing policies (picking the mode, deciding when to spend on the strong mode, a zero-cost rule read off the task text, a confidence cascade, and pooled cost tiers), and none robustly beats simply fixing one well-chosen mode; the one exception is a fragile result in our sparsest cell. The central obstruction is that routing supervision is produced at the agent's success rate: the weaker the agent, the fewer labels a router gets, exactly where routing would be most valuable. This limit belongs to today's agents rather than to routing itself. Label supply and routing opportunity rise together (correlation 0.95 across cells), so a stronger agent can overturn the result, and we report the rerun noise bands and the full measurement protocol.
articles.comment: Preprint. Under review at the Second Workshop for Research on Agent Language Models (REALM), EMNLP 2026 (non-archival track)
articles.titleCn: 路由在价值最大处最难学习：面向网络代理的表示路由界限
articles.abstractCn: 网络代理通过文本、像素或两者结合来观察浏览器，并且这种选择通常对所有任务都是固定的。我们在VisualWebArena和WebArena的八个站点模型组合（单元格）上测量了六种观察模式，并询问按任务选择模式能带来什么好处。这些模式是互补的：每种模式都能解决其他模式遗漏的任务，它们以不同的结构方式失败，并且最佳选择在不同任务集之间切换。显而易见的奖赏，即能为每个任务挑选出最佳模式的预言者，看起来很大，但被运行间的噪声夸大了：在相同任务上重新运行相同模式会改变12-14%的结果，因此已经掌握的模式进行第二次运行所获得的收益与增加新模式大致相同。留存下来的是成本界限：将所有模式都无法解决的任务发送到最便宜的模式，在八个单元格中有八个能将成本降低9.5-30.6%，且成功率保持不变。然后我们测试了五种路由策略（选择模式、决定何时花费在强模式上、从任务文本中读取的无成本规则、置信度级联和汇总成本层），但没有一种策略能稳健地优于简单地固定一个精心选择的模式；唯一的例外是我们最稀疏单元格中的一个脆弱结果。核心障碍在于路由监督是在代理的成功率下产生的：代理越弱，路由器获得的标签就越少，而路由最需要帮助的地方恰恰是这里。这个限制属于当今的代理，而不是路由本身。标签供应和路由机会一起增长（单元格间的相关性为0.95），因此更强的代理可以推翻这一结果，我们报告了重新运行噪声范围和完整测量协议。

articles.title: Schema-Guided Hierarchical Information Extraction and Semantic Evaluation Using Generative AI
articles.abstract: We present a schema-based framework for extracting complex, structured information from unstructured text documents using generative AI, followed by automated semantic evaluation of the extracted information against a gold standard. The schema, serving as an information model encoding domain knowledge, provides a unified, systematic, and consistent framework for extraction of hierarchical, nested information, with attributes of variable cardinality, and subsequent evaluation of the results. Information extraction from a document is performed in a single call to the model, in zero-shot mode. In the evaluation step, we introduce a path-based semantic matching algorithm to align the nested, variable-cardinality attributes in the extracted results with those in the gold standard. We use generative AI for semantic comparison of the extracted and gold standard values of an attribute, and introduce a rubric to classify the result of the comparison, according to domain-specific considerations, as an exact, semantic, useful, or non-match. We were able to extract 12 out of 14 attributes with an F1 score of $>$90\% from documents published by the health technology assessment organisation NICE, using the generative AI model Claude Opus 3. The time needed to extract the attributes from a document was $\sim$30 times lower than the time taken by a human domain expert. We further demonstrate generalisability of this framework across different generative AI models and transferability across different HTA organisations and languages.
articles.comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. To be published in Proceedings of the 2026 IEEE 22nd International Conference on e-Science (e-Science), Naples, Italy
articles.titleCn: 基于模式的分层信息抽取与生成式AI的语义评估
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了一种基于模式的框架，用于利用生成式人工智能从非结构化文本文档中提取复杂、结构化信息，并随后对提取的信息进行与黄金标准自动语义评估。该模式作为编码领域知识的信息模型，为提取层次化、嵌套信息（具有可变基数属性）提供了一个统一、系统且一致的框架，并用于后续结果评估。文档中的信息提取通过模型单次调用、零样本模式完成。在评估步骤中，我们引入了一种基于路径的语义匹配算法，用于将提取结果中的嵌套、可变基数属性与黄金标准中的属性进行对齐。我们使用生成式人工智能对提取属性和黄金标准值进行语义比较，并根据特定领域的考虑，引入评分标准将比较结果分类为精确、语义、有用或非匹配。我们使用生成式人工智能模型Claude Opus 3从健康技术评估组织NICE发布的文档中提取了14个属性中的12个，F1分数达到90%以上。从文档中提取属性所需的时间比人类领域专家所需的时间低约30倍。我们进一步展示了该框架在不同生成式人工智能模型间的泛化能力，以及在不同健康技术评估组织和语言间的可迁移性。

articles.title: Decolonizing Linguistic Policies in Automated Speech Recognition: A Framework for Cross-Culturally Competent Speech AI
articles.abstract: This paper focuses on automatic speech recognition (ASR) and ASR-mediated voice interfaces that shape access to public services, healthcare, and education. We argue that persistent failures for low-resource, Indigenous, and non-standard language varieties are not only technical errors, but also implicit linguistic policies that reproduce colonial language hierarchies. Drawing on linguistic capital, raciolinguistic ideology, language policy research, and decolonial computing, we show how data, metrics, and model priors determine whose voices become machine-legible. We introduce the Three Harms (3M) taxonomy---Misrecognition, Misalignment, and Mistrust---and a seven-layer situatedness model for linguistic diversity in ASR and ASR-mediated voice interfaces. We then propose a participatory framework and minimum audit protocol for culturally competent ASR, positioning affected communities as co-designers, evaluators, and governance partners.
articles.comment: 10 Pages, 2 Figures, 2 Tables, Interspeech 2026 - Sydney, Australia
articles.titleCn: 自动化语音识别中的语言政策去殖民化：跨文化胜任型语音人工智能的框架
articles.abstractCn: 本文聚焦于自动语音识别（ASR）技术及其介导的语音界面，这些技术塑造了公众服务、医疗保健和教育领域的访问方式。我们认为，低资源、原住民语言和非标准语言变体的持续识别失败不仅是技术错误，更是隐含的语言政策，这些政策复制了殖民语言等级制度。基于语言资本、种族语言意识形态、语言政策研究和去殖民化计算，我们展示了数据、指标和模型先验如何决定哪些人的声音可以被机器识别。我们提出了“三害”（3M）分类法——误识别、错位和误解——以及用于ASR和ASR介导语音界面的七层情境化模型，以体现语言多样性。随后，我们提出了一个具有文化胜任力的ASR参与式框架和最低审计协议，将受影响社群定位为共同设计者、评估者和治理伙伴。

articles.title: Poli-Bias: Understanding and Measuring Large Language Model Biases in International Political Conflicts
articles.abstract: Measuring political bias in large language models (LLMs) remains challenging as it can manifest through subtle differences in framing, argumentation, and legal reasoning that are difficult to capture with a single metric. In this work, we introduce Poli-Bias, a counterfactual framework for measuring whether LLMs treat legally equivalent conflict scenarios differently depending on the countries involved. Poli-Bias compares responses to paired prompts in which country identities are systematically swapped across diverse geopolitical relationships, legal violations, and reasoning tasks. Rather than reducing bias to a single judgment, our framework decomposes response disparities into five interpretable dimensions, revealing how and where unequal treatment manifests. Across 13 contemporary LLMs spanning diverse model families and sizes, we find that country identities and user affiliations can systematically affect how equivalent actions are described, evaluated, and defended under international law. Our results thus establish Poli-Bias as a fine-grained framework for auditing political even-handedness and sycophancy in LLMs.
articles.titleCn: Poli-Bias：理解和测量国际政治冲突中大语言模型的偏见
articles.abstractCn: 在大型语言模型（LLMs）中测量政治偏见仍然具有挑战性，因为其可能通过措辞、论证和法律推理中的细微差异来体现，而这些差异难以通过单一指标来捕捉。在这项工作中，我们引入了Poli-Bias，一个反事实框架，用于测量LLMs是否会根据所涉及的国家不同，对法律上等效的冲突场景进行差异化处理。Poli-Bias通过系统地交换不同地缘政治关系、法律违规行为和推理任务中的国家身份，比较成对提示的响应。我们的框架并非将偏见简化为单一判断，而是将响应差异分解为五个可解释的维度，揭示不平等待遇是如何以及在哪里体现的。在涵盖不同模型家族和规模的13个当代LLMs中，我们发现国家身份和用户归属会系统性地影响在国际法下对等效行为的描述、评估和辩护方式。因此，我们的结果将Poli-Bias确立为一个用于审计LLMs中政治公正性和奉承行为的细粒度框架。

articles.title: Beyond Sequence Order: Syntax-Informed Positional Embeddings for Transformers
articles.abstract: Positional embeddings (PE) in Transformers encode token distance and order but are largely agnostic to \textit{syntactic structure}. We introduce \textbf{S}yntax-\textbf{i}nformed \textbf{P}ositional \textbf{E}mbeddings (\textbf{SiPE}), which learns a lightweight syntactic prior from dependency parses during pretraining and injects it across all three dominant PE families (absolute, relative, rotary), for both encoders and decoders, leaving self-attention and the rest of the architecture untouched. We isolate \emph{where} and \emph{how} the prior should enter the model, and find it depends on the architecture: for autoregressive decoders that use relative PE, the prior is strongest when coupled multiplicatively with the relative-position term of the attention score, outperforming injection into the input embeddings, into self-attention, or into the positional and attention terms jointly---while for encoders it is best added directly to the input embeddings, composing with each encoder's native positional mechanism. We find that models pre-trained with SiPE improve on the SyntaxGym benchmark by up to $10.3\%$ while simultaneously reducing perplexity by $9.0\%$ over a base model with no syntactic supervision---a metric nearly every existing syntax-injection method instead degrades. Crucially, these gains extend beyond syntactic generalization: SiPE also improves real-world language understanding, raising scores on the GLUE benchmark by up to $8.2\%$ over a model trained without it. Unlike existing syntactic language models that marginalize over many parses at inference or discard syntax at runtime, SiPE conditions on a single parse, establishing a new Pareto frontier between syntactic supervision and inference cost.
articles.titleCn: 超越序列顺序：Transformer的句法信息位置嵌入
articles.abstractCn: Transformer中的位置编码（PE）编码了标记的距离和顺序，但对句法结构基本无感知。我们引入了句法信息位置编码（SiPE），它从预训练期间的依存句法分析中学习轻量级的句法先验，并将其注入到所有三种主要的PE家族（绝对、相对、旋转）中，同时影响编码器和解码器，而无需触及自注意力机制和其余架构。我们隔离了先验应该进入模型的时机和方式，发现这取决于架构：对于使用相对PE的自回归解码器，当先验与注意力分数的相对位置项相乘时效果最强，优于注入输入嵌入、注入自注意力或同时注入位置和注意力项——而对于编码器，最佳方式是直接添加到输入嵌入，并与每个编码器固有的位置机制相结合。我们发现，使用SiPE进行预训练的模型在SyntaxGym基准测试上的表现提高了高达10.3%，同时在不带句法监督的基础模型上降低了困惑度9.0%——而几乎现有的句法注入方法都会降低这一指标。关键的是，这些提升不仅超越了句法泛化：SiPE也提高了现实世界的语言理解能力，在不使用它的模型上，GLUE基准测试得分提高了高达8.2%。与现有在推理时忽略多个解析或运行时丢弃句法的句法语言模型不同，SiPE基于单个解析，在句法监督和推理成本之间建立了新的帕累托前沿。

articles.title: From Siloed Algorithms to Compliance-First Agentic Platforms: A Multi-Layered Architecture for Hospital AI Systems
articles.abstract: Hospitals are rapidly adopting artificial intelligence for triage, imaging, scheduling etc., yet most deployments remain isolated point solutions locked inside departmental silos, resulting in duplicated effort, hidden risks, and unrealized enterprise value. Despite explosive growth of AI in healthcare market and accelerating investment, an estimated 70-80% of healthcare AI pilots fail to scale, largely due to governance gaps, fragmented data, and missing integration blueprints. This research proposes a hospital-specific, compliance-first, Agentic AI architecture with multiple interoperable layers, extending existing hospital AI platform models with: (i) an Agent Orchestration Layer for multi-agent workflows across clinical, operational, and financial domains, (ii) a Compliance and Policy Layer that centralizes policy-as-code for HIPAA, GDPR, the EU AI Act, DISHA Act, India's DPDP Act, and ISO/IEC security and safety standards, and (iii) a Privacy-Preserving Data Fabric that plugs federated learning, differential privacy, and secure enclaves into real-world Hospital Information Management System (HIMS) flows. Using a synthetic but structurally realistic hospital dataset and an open, ready-to-deploy prototype implementation, this study demonstrates the end-to-end orchestration of triage risk prediction, workflow optimization, and compliance logging, achieving substantial simulated reductions in task turnaround times and manual documentation effort while maintaining policy-guarded data access. The resulting architecture offers hospital leaders a pragmatic blueprint to move from ad hoc tools to a governed, globally compliant, ROI-focused AI platform that can be tailored to on-premise, hybrid and cloud-native deployments.
articles.titleCn: 从孤立算法到合规优先的智能平台：医院人工智能系统的多层架构
articles.abstractCn: 医院正迅速采用人工智能进行分诊、影像分析、日程安排等，但大多数部署仍停留在部门隔离的独立解决方案，导致重复劳动、隐藏风险和未实现的企业价值。尽管医疗健康市场的人工智能应用呈爆炸式增长，投资也在加速，但据估计有70%-80%的医疗人工智能试点项目未能规模化推广，主要原因是治理缺失、数据碎片化以及缺乏集成蓝图。本研究提出了一种针对医院、合规优先的智能代理架构，具有多层互操作设计，在现有医院人工智能平台模型基础上扩展了：(i) 跨临床、运营和财务领域的多智能体工作流编排层；(ii) 集中管理HIPAA、GDPR、欧盟人工智能法案、DISHA法案、印度DPDP法案以及ISO/IEC安全和标准政策的合规与政策层；(iii) 保护隐私的数据结构，将联邦学习、差分隐私和安全隔间嵌入真实世界医院信息系统(HIMS)流程中。本研究使用合成但结构真实的医院数据集和可即部署的原型实现，展示了分诊风险预测、工作流优化和合规日志的全流程编排，在维持受政策保护的数据访问的同时，显著模拟减少了任务周转时间和手动文档工作量。该架构为医院领导者提供了从临时工具转向受监管、全球合规、以投资回报为焦点的AI平台的实用蓝图，可根据本地部署、混合部署和云原生部署进行定制。

articles.title: ECHO: A Locally-Deployable Agentic Health Assistant with Temporal Memory, Safety Guardrails, and Speech Assessment
articles.abstract: This paper presents ECHO (Enhanced Care & Health Observer), a locally-deployable conversational health assistant for long-term chronic care management. ECHO integrates three complementary software modules developed under shared supervision as a unified system. The core module is an agentic chatbot built on a ReAct loop orchestrated via LangGraph, equipped with 17 clinical tools and a temporal knowledge graph for persistent cross-session memory; it achieves a 94.9% tool-execution pass rate across a 59-scenario benchmark with GPT-5 Mini. A two-stage hybrid safety layer intercepts all incoming queries: a rule-based layer handles explicit crisis signals and jailbreak attempts in under 1ms, while a signed graph neural network (GNN) with APPNP-style propagation classifies boundary cases by clinical intent, achieving 88.8% accuracy and 90.6% unsafe recall on a 2,537-query annotated Turkish health dataset while outperforming zero-shot LLM baselines including Llama 3.3 70B. A multimodal speech assessment module combining Whisper acoustic encoding and BERT text encoding with cross-attention fusion estimates emotion, depression, and pain, reaching a mean macro F1 of 0.652. The full system is implemented as a web application that can run entirely on consumer hardware, with no patient data transmitted to external services, supporting compliance with GDPR and KVKK.
articles.titleCn: ECHO：一个具有时序记忆、安全护栏和语音评估的本地部署智能健康助手
articles.abstractCn: 本文介绍了ECHO（增强护理与健康观察器），一种用于长期慢性病管理的本地部署式对话式健康助手。ECHO集成了在共同监督下开发的三个互补软件模块，作为一个统一系统。核心模块是一个基于ReAct循环、通过LangGraph协调的代理式聊天机器人，配备了17种临床工具和用于持久跨会话记忆的时间知识图谱；它在59个场景基准测试中，使用GPT-5 Mini实现了94.9%的工具执行通过率。一个两阶段混合安全层拦截所有传入查询：基于规则的层在1毫秒内处理显式危机信号和越狱尝试，而一个具有APPNP风格传播的签名图神经网络（GNN）通过临床意图对边界案例进行分类，在2537个标注的土耳其健康数据集上达到88.8%的准确率和90.6%的不安全召回率，并优于包括Llama 3.3 70B在内的零样本LLM基线。一个结合Whisper声学编码和BERT文本编码、通过交叉注意力融合的多模态语音评估模块，用于估计情绪、抑郁和疼痛，平均宏观F1达到0.652。整个系统作为一个可在消费级硬件上完全运行的Web应用程序实现，无需将患者数据传输到外部服务，支持符合GDPR和KVKK。

articles.title: Training-Free Token-Level Steering for LLM Personalized Co-Writing
articles.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) show great promise for personalization, they often lack specialized domain knowledge. Conventional solutions like fine-tuning struggle with high computational costs and rapid data updates, while Retrieval-Augmented Generation fails to provide fine-grained, token-level steering. Furthermore, chat-based interfaces remain dominant, whereas productive co-writing paradigms have not yet been well exploited beyond the coding domain. To this end, we introduce SteerWrite, a training-free framework designed for personalized co-writing. Our method effectively adapts the base model to specialized domains without gradient updates, with specific designs tailored to small datasets. Experiments demonstrate that SteerWrite achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse datasets, metrics, and models, significantly reducing human editing effort.
articles.titleCn: 无训练的token级引导用于LLM个性化合写
articles.abstractCn: 虽然大型语言模型（LLM）在个性化方面展现出巨大潜力，但它们通常缺乏特定领域的专业知识。传统的解决方案，如微调，面临着高昂的计算成本和快速数据更新的挑战，而检索增强生成则无法提供细粒度的、基于token级别的引导。此外，基于聊天的界面仍然占据主导地位，而富有成效的合作写作范式尚未在编码领域之外得到充分利用。为此，我们引入了SteerWrite，这是一个无需训练的个性化合作写作框架。我们的方法能够在无需梯度更新的情况下有效地将基础模型适应到特定领域，并针对小数据集进行了专门设计。实验表明，SteerWrite在多种数据集、指标和模型上均达到了最先进的性能，显著减少了人工编辑的工作量。

articles.title: LangChoiceBench: Measuring and Explaining Programming-Language Choice in LLMs
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have been shown to exhibit strong Python preferences when generating project-level code, but there is currently no systematic way to measure this behaviour across new models. To bridge this gap, we introduce LangChoiceBench, a project-level code-generation benchmark for measuring Python preference, recommendation-implementation consistency, and language diversity. LangChoiceBench covers 28 projects across seven software areas where Python is often a poor default.
